$PROBLEM Daridorexant | daridorexant N020_rep12 | FOCEI $ABBR DERIV2=NO $INPUT ID TIME AMT DV MDV EVID CMT LDOSE FASTED FED MORNING LLBW LFM LAGE LALP $DATA data.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBROUTINES ADVAN13 TOL=9 ATOL=12 $MODEL COMP=(DEPOT,DEFDOSE) COMP=(CENTRAL,DEFOBS) COMP=(PERIPH)
$PK ; individual parameters: theta_i = exp(MU + ETA), MU = log(typical value) [+ covariate effects]; ; parameters without IIV have an ETA with OMEGA 0 FIX (MU referencing for FOCE FAST) MU_1 = LOG(THETA(1)/(1 - THETA(1))) + THETA(9)*LDOSE FBIO = 1/(1 + EXP(-(MU_1 + ETA(1)))) MU_2 = LOG(THETA(2)) + THETA(10)*FASTED + THETA(11)*FED TLAG = EXP(MU_2 + ETA(2)) MU_3 = LOG(THETA(3)) + THETA(12)*FASTED + THETA(13)*FED + THETA(14)*MORNING KA = EXP(MU_3 + ETA(3)) MU_4 = LOG(THETA(4)) + THETA(15)*LLBW VC = EXP(MU_4 + ETA(4)) MU_5 = LOG(THETA(5)) + THETA(16)*LFM VP = EXP(MU_5 + ETA(5)) MU_6 = LOG(THETA(6)) + THETA(17)*LFM Q = EXP(MU_6 + ETA(6)) MU_7 = LOG(THETA(7)) VM = EXP(MU_7 + ETA(7)) MU_8 = LOG(THETA(8)) + THETA(18)*LLBW + THETA(19)*LAGE + THETA(20)*LALP KM = EXP(MU_8 + ETA(8)) F1 = FBIO ALAG1 = TLAG
$DES CC = A(2)/VC DADT(1) = -KA*A(1) DADT(2) = KA*A(1) - VM*CC/(KM + CC) - Q/VC*A(2) + Q/VP*A(3) DADT(3) = Q/VC*A(2) - Q/VP*A(3)
$ERROR IPRED = 1000*A(2)/VC W = THETA(21) + THETA(22)*IPRED Y = IPRED + W*EPS(1)
$THETA (0, 0.49029543, 1) ; 1 F_pop (0, 0.28444636) ; 2 tlag_pop (0, 0.63113737) ; 3 ka_pop (0, 20.464648) ; 4 Vc_pop (0, 9.5717287) ; 5 Vp_pop (0, 5.0075225) ; 6 Q_pop (0, 4.8546334) ; 7 Vm_pop (0, 3.5382748) ; 8 Km_pop 0.1 ; 9 beta_F_COV_LDOSE 0.1 ; 10 beta_tlag_COV_FASTED 0.1 ; 11 beta_tlag_COV_FED 0.1 ; 12 beta_ka_COV_FASTED 0.1 ; 13 beta_ka_COV_FED 0.1 ; 14 beta_ka_COV_MORNING 0.1 ; 15 beta_Vc_COV_LLBW 0.1 ; 16 beta_Vp_COV_LFM 0.1 ; 17 beta_Q_COV_LFM 0.1 ; 18 beta_Km_COV_LLBW 0.1 ; 19 beta_Km_COV_LAGE 0.1 ; 20 beta_Km_COV_LALP (0, 10.0) ; 21 a (0, 0.3) ; 22 b
$OMEGA 0.25 ; ETA(1) F (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(2) tlag (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(3) ka (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(4) Vc (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(5) Vp (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(6) Q (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(7) Vm (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(8) Km (omega = 0.5)
$SIGMA 1 FIX ; EPS(1) Conc, sd = a + b*IPRED via THETA
; -2LL: importance sampling (EONLY=1), proposal t with 5 df; first IMP adapts the proposal, ; the second evaluates with 10000 samples per individual (as Monolix). Reported value: ; 'OBJECTIVE FUNCTION VALUE WITH CONSTANT' of the last step. $EST METHOD=COND INTERACTION FAST MAXEVAL=9999 NSIG=3 SIGL=9 PRINT=5 NOABORT FORMAT=s1PE17.10 $EST METHOD=IMP INTERACTION EONLY=1 NITER=5 ISAMPLE=1000 DF=5 ISCALE_MIN=1 ISCALE_MAX=1 MAPITER=0 CTYPE=0 SIGL=9 PRINT=1 SEED=23456 NOCOV=1 FORMAT=s1PE17.10 $EST METHOD=IMP INTERACTION EONLY=1 NITER=1 ISAMPLE=10000 DF=5 ISCALE_MIN=1 ISCALE_MAX=1 MAPITER=0 CTYPE=0 SIGL=9 PRINT=1 SEED=34567 NOCOV=1 FNLETA=0
